./banner.reason: Banner fixes inline Notification presentation; Callout delegates to Banner. The aliases keep the shared notice contract.

./toast.reason: Toast fixes floating Notification presentation; Toaster and service functions delegate to the shared notification engine.

Aggregate library entry; UI families are covered through their individual public entry points.
supportEntries../theme: Theme provider and profile application support.
supportEntries../ai: AI data types and domain helpers; no model service implementation.
supportEntries../patterns: Aggregate pattern entry; individual pattern entries carry behavior contracts.
supportEntries../filters: Filter data models and helpers, governed by the filtering contracts.
supportEntries../time-range: Time-range model and parsing helpers, governed by TimeRangePicker requirements.
supportEntries../utils: Class composition utility; not a UI family.
supportEntries../primitives: Direct Base UI exports; behavior belongs to the upstream primitive API and headless boundary check.
supportEntries../agentic: Agent infrastructure and project policy API; governed by the kit, composition and service protocol contracts.

limitations: Coverage means each published UI entry has a source-identity contract or explicit compatibility mapping; it is not per-function test coverage or certification.
Nested exports within a family share that family's contract. Support entries and asset files are classified separately and are not counted as authored UI behavior.
